title: AB Download Manager: free IDM alternative
caption:
IDM charges $11.95/year. AB Download Manager speeds up your downloads for free ⚡

✅ Downloads each file in several parts at once
✅ Pause and resume any download
✅ Queues and a scheduler for big batches
✅ Browser extension grabs download links for you, 100% free

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux · Android
ℹ️ The browser extension is a separate install from the Chrome or Firefox store. On Windows you can install with winget; other platforms grab the download from GitHub Releases

Comment "FILES" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
